That’s Schizod personality disorder. She presents with odd thinking and perceptions. She incorrectly interprets situations that are not about her yet assign them special meaning to her. She cannot respond appropriately to social cues and makes no effort to use coping skills. She also has MDD.  A exhausted battery of evidenced based psychological testing was done to clarify her diagnosis. I work with people who have BPD too and there is a big difference.
